about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the world of the kingdom of Caerwynn, where the secrets of the past await their moment to be revealed! The influential landowner John Brave and the renowned archaeologist Ronan O’Keir join forces to uncover the ancient secrets of the Empire of Tenkai — a civilization swallowed by time. Explore forgotten temples and hidden shrines, discover rare artifacts, and forge trade alliances. Uncover lost knowledge and become part of a great history! The fate of Tenkai is in your hands. Will you raise it from the ruins or let history fade forever?

Game Features:

  • A new character – Ronan O’Keir – is eager for shared adventures!

  • A captivating story with a medieval spirit!

  • Countless incredible details enrich the lore of John Brave's homeland!

  • Discover the secrets of ancient rituals and traditions of the Empire of Tenkai!

  • Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the game with amazing music and graphics that evoke the spirit of the era!

  • A wide variety of locations – explore every corner of this world!
